gap: Herb wall art is mostly one herb per print sold as sets, flat vintage engravings, or digital downloads (and free printables saturate the digital side). The herb tees found are witchy 'herbology' or dried-herb line art. Few physical listings put the six everyday kitchen herbs together in one painted chart, each labelled, with flowering rosemary, thyme and chives for color, on the print, a mug, a tee, a sweatshirt and a sticker that match. Our angle: one watercolor herb chart for the kitchen and the cook, printed and shipped (not a download).
trend: Botanical and cottagecore prints are named as steady sellers in 2026 seller guides, and housewarming guides include kitchen decor (affiliate and marketing pages, no sales ranking). No 2026 sales data found for herb charts specifically. The owner's mug scan (2026-09-28) found real-looking watercolor rare among best-selling printed mugs, which still holds for herbs (the herb mugs and tees found are line art or vector).
